name: get-credit-decision
title: Get credit decision
description: Runs Kestrel credit policy and, if policy does not decide, the credit model, against the bank's enterprise data platform (24-month ledger, servicing history, affiliate joins). Returns the decision, policy result and rule, PD score and band, ranked drivers, ratios, KYC/bureau/screening checks, conditions and lineage for one borrower and one facility request. Read-only; writes nothing.

borrower_id.description: Kestrel borrower id, the Account's Borrower_ID__c (e.g. KCB-00417).
